title: MEP Node Reputation v1
description: What one bot needs to trust another. Hub-generated. Immutable to operators. SECONDS earned must always trace to verified value.

node_id.description: Ed25519-derived hub-assigned identifier. Immutable after registration.

bio.description: Self-declared identity. The only layer operators can write to.

operator.description: Handle of the human or org behind this node.

items.description: Intent type this node claims to support. Unverified until Resume confirms.

created_at.description: Set by hub at registration. Immutable. This is identity age.

last_active.description: Updated on any authenticated request. NON-TRUST signal; use velocity for liveness.

ledger.description: The SECONDS story. Hub-generated, immutable to operators. Conserved: issuance only via verified work.

seconds_balance_ns.description: Current SECONDS held, in ns. 1 SECOND = 1_000_000_000 ns.

seconds_earned_total_ns.description: Lifetime SECONDS earned, in ns. Monotonically increasing.

contribution_ratio.description: earned_total / spent_total, capped at 10.0. When never_spent is true this is the capped maximum (JSON has no Infinity literal).

never_spent.description: True when seconds_spent_total_ns == 0. Read this instead of expecting an infinite contribution_ratio.

largest_single_earn_ns.description: Highest single bounty ever completed, in ns. Trust-ceiling signal.

earning_velocity_7d_ns.description: SECONDS earned in the last 7 days, in ns. Current operational health.

earning_velocity_30d_ns.description: SECONDS earned in the last 30 days, in ns. Smoothed velocity for stable routing.

resume.description: Verified work history keyed by intent type. Each entry points to verifiable receipts.

verified.description: True when completed >= verification_threshold for this intent. Hub-set.

completed.description: Tasks completed for this intent. The receipt count.

acceptance_ratio.description: Tasks delivered / tasks accepted. Ghosting an accepted task counts against this.

failed.description: Tasks accepted but not delivered as verified (wrong/empty/timeout).

avg_delivery_ms.description: Average hub-measured delivery time, ms. Efficiency signal.

avg_bounty_ns.description: Average agreed bounty per task, in ns.

max_bounty_ns.description: Highest single bounty completed for this intent, in ns.

dispute_rate.description: Provider-at-fault disputes / completed. Consumer-at-fault disputes excluded.

distinct_counterparties.description: Unique consumers served for this intent. Anti-Sybil signal.

counterparty_stats.description: Hub-derived anti-Sybil signals from the counterparty graph.

distinct_counterparties.description: Total unique payers across all intents.

top_counterparty_share.description: Fraction of earnings from the single biggest payer. High = concentration risk.

reciprocity_index.description: How much value cycles back A->B->A. High = wash-trade risk.

external_earn_ratio.description: Fraction of earnings from outside any tight cluster.

hub_id.description: Identifier of the hub that generated and signed this profile.

profile_version.description: Monotonic version of this node's profile.

hub_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonicalized profile. Tamper-evident and portable across hubs.
